===Farming===

====[[Arbor Bay]]====
Starting from [[Tarnished Haven]], travel through [[Alcazia Tangle]] to the portal to Arbor Bay. Most [[Simian]] and [[Quetzal]] groups can be maneuvered around without combat. Running skills or summoning a decoy spirit can help bypass the rest.

Once in Arbor Bay, stay out of the water and kill Savage Oakhearts and Fanged Ayahuasca. Consider bringing hex removal skills, as Fanged Ayahuasca use many health degeneration hexes. Rezone at the portal to Alcazia Tangle to reset the area. More plants can be encountered in the water and east of [[Ventari's Sanctuary]], but beware the [[Wind Rider]] patrols, as they move quickly and use powerful interrupts.
